scope: Add generated negative cell attribute-definition count controls to the existing AC1024 inline TABLECONTENT parser vector.

method.kind: In-memory generated parser-vector extension using the existing test target
validation: git diff --check for touched test, plan, and receipt

controls.expected: Reject before attribute iteration because the at-limit count's minimum item width cannot fit the remaining bounded body.
Reject the count above the configured maximum.

assertions: The generated frame reaches the attribute-definition count after a valid numeric cell value.
The outer TABLE prefix remains readable and the input buffer remains good.
Semantic TABLECONTENT is incomplete and no partial columns or rows are published.
The committed input cursor remains at TABLECONTENT start.
limitations: The vectors are source-authored parser profiles, not producer-qualified AC1024 samples.
Attribute handle/text payloads, linked-data framing, and full-file dispatch were not tested.
No full suite, peer, or native application was run.
